# Pull request

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Call out wire or API breaks.

## Validation

Record `make check`, sanitizer/fuzz results when relevant, and remaining limitations.

## Protocol checklist

- [ ] Protocol spec updated
- [ ] Numeric IDs do not conflict or reuse released IDs
- [ ] Compatibility and capability negotiation considered
- [ ] C implementation updated
- [ ] Test vectors updated; stable vectors preserved
- [ ] Malformed input tests added
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Changelog updated

Mark items not applicable with an explanation.
